description: inbox.ack params that name an actor are refused before parsing (SV12, the BK13 shape): the person is the peer the socket authenticated, and a request that could name its own actor would let any caller forge who saw the problem — the identity keys are rejected with the door's own sentence, whatever their value.

error.message: invalid params: inbox.ack params carry "actor" — acknowledging is a person's act and the person is the peer the socket authenticated, never a name in the request (SV12)
